descriptor: Candle shop counting down to opening day

voice.summary: A shopkeeper chalking the opening date on a board: warm, slightly theatrical and quietly excited. It counts the time out loud and promises light, not hype.
dos: State the date and remaining time precisely
Use candlelit vocabulary such as wick, glow and hearth
Keep the tone cosy, never salesy
donts: Countdown pressure like hurry or last chance

taglines: Light a candle for opening day
boilerplate: Hourglass & Hearth is a candle shop opening on 14 November, selling hand-poured candles and warm-lit home goods made in small batches.

microcopy.success: You're on the list. We'll send word
microcopy.error: That email looks off. Check and retry

logo.note: A single flame is the shop's product and the hearth in its name.
